SITE INSPECTION REPORT
Building A, Level 3
Date: 2026-09-15
Inspector: J. Smith
Report Reference: INS-2026-0915-BA3
Status: Pending Approval

EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
This report documents findings from the scheduled safety and compliance inspection
of Building A, Level 3 conducted on 2026-09-15. Three findings were identified
requiring attention prior to formal approval.

SECTION 1 — ELECTRICAL SYSTEMS
Finding ID: EL-001
Severity: HIGH
Description: Panel board EL-3A has three circuit breakers rated at 40A serving
circuits with 20A wire gauge. This constitutes an overrated protection situation
and presents a fire risk under sustained load conditions.
Recommended Action: Replace affected circuit breakers with 20A rated units.
Contractor: Licensed electrician required. Target completion: 2026-10-01.

SECTION 2 — STRUCTURAL INTEGRITY
Finding ID: ST-002
Severity: MEDIUM
Description: Expansion joint covers on the west corridor show visible separation
of approximately 8mm beyond rated tolerance. No structural compromise observed
but monitoring and remediation is recommended.
Recommended Action: Replace expansion joint covers to specification.
Contractor: Building maintenance team. Target completion: 2026-10-15.

SECTION 3 — FIRE SAFETY
Finding ID: FS-003
Severity: HIGH
Description: Sprinkler head FS-3-14 in storage room 3-B is obstructed by
shelving installed without clearance compliance. Current clearance is 120mm;
minimum required is 450mm.
Recommended Action: Relocate shelving to restore required clearance.
Contractor: Facilities management. Target completion: 2026-09-22.

APPROVAL CRITERIA
All HIGH severity findings must be resolved and verified before formal approval.
MEDIUM severity findings must have confirmed remediation plans with scheduled
completion dates within 30 days of inspection date.

INSPECTOR DECLARATION
I certify that the findings documented in this report accurately represent the
conditions observed during the inspection conducted on 2026-09-15.
Signed: J. Smith, Certified Safety Inspector (CSI-4821)
